textRuns.value: in 2005, 61.0% of people in countries that were high-income at the time were online, but only 52.7% in today's high-income countries, because several of them joined the group later. The same effect explains the drop in lower-middle-income speed in 2026 Q3 under "classification at the time": the FY27 list took effect in July 2026 and moved some countries between groups. Low-income data stop in 2019 (in 2016 under the FY27 list): since 2020, countries with about a fifth of the group's population (Sudan, Yemen, North Korea, Syria, South Sudan, Eritrea) have not reported, so the group value is hidden (coverage below 90%).
